grammarFocus: be 动词否定句与一般疑问句；what / who；简短肯定和否定回答。
title: A Simple Phone Call
instructions: 听录音，完成8个问题。录音会播放两遍。请仔细听，答案必须来自录音内容。本材料为模拟练习，不是官方雅思考试。
transcript: A: Hello, this is Anna. Are you Ben? B: No, I am not Ben. I am Tom. Ben is my brother. A: Oh, sorry. Is Ben at home? B: No, he is not. He is at work. A: Is your sister at home? B: Yes, she is. She is in the kitchen. A: What is her name? B: Her name is Lily. A: Is Lily a teacher? B: No, she is not a teacher. She is a student. A: Who is in the living room? B: My mother is in the living room. A: Is your mother a doctor? B: No, she is not a doctor. She is a nurse. A: Thank you. Goodbye. B: Goodbye.

questions.explanation: 录音中，B说“I am Tom.”，所以接电话的是Tom。
录音中，B明确回答“No, he is not.”，所以Ben不在家。

questions.prompt: What is the name of Tom's sister? (Use one word.)
questions.explanation: 录音中，B说“Her name is Lily.”，所以Tom的妹妹叫Lily。
录音中，B回答“No, she is not a teacher.”，所以Lily不是老师。
questions.evidence: No, she is not a teacher.

questions.prompt: Who is in the living room?
questions.explanation: 录音中，B说“My mother is in the living room.”，所以在客厅的是Tom的妈妈。
questions.evidence: My mother is in the living room.

questions.explanation: 录音中，B回答“No, she is not a doctor.”，所以Tom的妈妈不是医生。
questions.evidence: No, she is not a doctor.

questions.prompt: What is Tom's mother's job? (Use one word.)
questions.explanation: 录音中，B说“She is a nurse.”，所以Tom的妈妈是护士。
录音中，B说“She is in the kitchen.”，这里的she指Lily，所以Lily在厨房。

grammar.title: be动词否定句与一般疑问句
grammar.explanation: be动词的否定句是在am/is/are后加not，如：I am not, he is not, she is not, you are not。一般疑问句是把be动词提到主语前面，如：Are you...? Is he...? 回答用Yes, I am. / No, I am not. 等。
grammar.example: Are you Ben? No, I am not Ben.

questions.explanation: 否定句在be动词后加not，所以是I am not a teacher.

questions.prompt: 选择正确的一般疑问句：

questions.explanation: I的be动词是am，所以肯定回答是Yes, I am.

questions.explanation: she的be动词是is，否定回答是No, she is not.
